open_risks: SETTLED, SEVERE (0083): the merge-boundary preflight is dead code on every host, macOS included. BOUNDARY_PREFLIGHT_CLI and readBoundaryPreflightVerdict occur once each in mitosis.js - their own definitions at :24 and :127. preflight-boundary occurs zero times.
The engine FAILS OPEN: with the verdict absent the run reaches decompose and returns all-shipped - no halt, no diagnostic. 7e2e7d7 (PR #8) deleted both call sites that 457d6fa (PR #5) added.

Silent because RECONCILE_SCHEMA at mitosis.js:1357 still declares boundaryPreflight optional and absent from required, so a reconcile result with no verdict validates cleanly. Enforcement was removed while its shape survived.

Criterion 3 is blocked on CODE, not only on the human. Applying runbook Sections 2-5 will not make Build A live while the wiring is severed - the server-side lock would exist and the engine would still never check it.

NOT DETERMINED, resolve before any fix: whether fix/mitosis-boundary-preflight (c59ca79) already restores the wiring, and whether 7e2e7d7 dropped it deliberately or via a bad merge resolution. Neither inspected.

LIVE: the engine authenticates as SatanshuMishra with permissions.admin=true. Repo is PUBLIC, personal-account owned; rulesets 0; rules/branches/main 0; collaborators = owner only. Build A INERT re-confirmed after the merge.

NEW: delete_branch_on_merge=false. Per runbook Section 5 auto-retargeting of a stacked child PR fires on DELETION of the merged head branch, not on the merge. 0047's deletion half is unconfigured, so retargeting never fires. Section 5 is TWO settings flips.

0047 is UNENFORCED, proven live not inferred: allow_squash_merge, allow_merge_commit and allow_rebase_merge are ALL true repo-side. Whoever clicks merge picks, and two of the three break every remaining PR in the stack.
Suite re-measured at beca874: tests 1540 | pass 1520 | fail 20, confirming the 18 BOUNDARY PREFLIGHT + 2 guardrail split. The 1540 figure is measured, not inherited.

The 2 guardrail failures ARE a test artifact (0083): protect-claude-config.sh:20-33 builds bases only from ~/.claude while the test at :8 derives REPO_CLAUDE from import.meta.url. They coincide only because ~/.claude symlinks into this repo.
.githooks/pre-commit runs the full suite, so while main is red NO commit lands without --no-verify. A guard bypassed by routine is a guard removed - fixing the suite is what restores it.

REFUTED (0084): semgrep detects secret-scanner.sh by SHEBANG as well as extension, so it is enqueued as BOTH python and bash and the python rules DO run - proven by an eval payload yielding 1 blocking finding. Residual: 4 bash rules wasted.

The ~97.5% and ~97.8% line-skip entries (ledger-compact-checkpoint.sh, ledger-precompact-checkpoint.sh) are the suspicious PartialParsing files and were NOT root-caused - not run. PartialParsing re-measured at 15 warnings across 9 files.

The live curl to semgrep.dev was sandbox-DENIED, so the upstream-drift half of the CI pin check is NOT RUN. The pin MATCHES over four cached copies - proving the config scanned with is the pinned content, not that upstream is unchanged.

Per 0071 the merge resolved two nosemgrep pragma lines toward the bare directive, OVERWRITING a human's same-line rewrite from PR #6 at live-inject.mjs:233 and live.mjs:216. Now on main. A one-line revert if the user disagrees.
Pre-existing, still NOT fixed: flagHasReachableTruePath's env probe has no left boundary, so `myprocess.env.X_ENABLED` returns true and lintFlags SKIPS the flag. Fails in the suppressing direction.

The security review recommends vendoring the canonical p/default content, which this thread scoped OUT. A hash-with-no-content pin cannot diff old rules against new, and drift recurred within 8 days. User call.

pr-create rejects a provenance model string carrying a bracketed context suffix (model=claude-opus-5[1m] was refused). Use the bare model id.
